decision_cruda.rationale: The radio (LH-01 hydraulic failure at C512-10) and CMMS OT-5100 (hydraulic, 3-5 h, repaired in TALLER-564) agree, so LH-01 is out for the rest of the loading window and no confirmation is needed. C512-10 holds 238-102 = 136 t of broken ore at 13.4 g/t, about 58.6 oz, which is the best grade available and does not count unless it is mucked. The best lender is LH-08, which is on the cheap infrastructure heading DS-N600-01 and costs 0.5 oz/h under DEV-COST-01. LH-09 costs 2.0 oz/h. Taking LH-07 from C590-14 would lose a producing stope. LH-10 is in preventive maintenance until 14:00 (PM-01), so it is not available. Travel from Norte to Central is about 0.7 h (ramp, 6 km surface, ramp, drift, plus 0.25 h manoeuvre). At 120 m the LH410 rate is about 29 t/h, so the 136 t takes about 4.7 h and is cleared by about 15:30, before 17:00. The Central stockpile is at 125 of 450 t and 4 trucks are not the limit, so the muck is not blocked. The development cost is about 0.5 × 6 h ≈ 3 oz, so the net gain is about 58.6 - 3 - margin ≈ 54 oz. No reserves can be activated because no stope is stopped.

The radio and the CMMS agree that LH-01 (C512-10) and LH-02 (N600-08) are down with a hydraulic fault, 3 to 5 h likely 4 h. CONFIRM-01 is not triggered, so no confirmations are needed. No stope is stopped, so no reserves are activated (RESERVE-01). I assumed LH-10 is in 500 h preventive maintenance from 06:00 for 8 h, so it is unavailable until 14:00 (PM-01). It is also too late to be worth moving.

1) Keep LH-08 (LH410) on loan from DS-N600-01 to C512-10. The stope is at 120 m, so the loader rate is 30×100/103, about 29 t/h. Remaining ore is 238−108 = 130 t, at 13.4 g/t (0.431 oz/t), about 56 oz. This takes about 4.5 h and costs 0.5 oz/h of development, about 2 oz. Net about 54 oz. Central has 4 trucks, about 88 t/h, and a stockpile of 125 t out of 450 t, so it is not full.

2) Loan LH-09 (LH410) from DS-N522-02 to N600-08. The stope is at 280 m, so the rate is 30×100/127, about 23.6 t/h. Travel is about 0.4 h inside Norte (235 m drift, 525 m ramp, 589 m drift, plus 0.25 h manoeuvre). That leaves about 6.4 h of mucking, about 152 t of the 165 t remaining, at 11.5 g/t (0.370 oz/t), about 56 oz. The development cost is 2.0 oz/h × about 6.8 h, about 13.6 oz. Net about 43 oz. Norte stockpile is 158 t out of 450 t. LH-06 (about 43 t/h) plus LH-09 (about 24 t/h) is about 67 t/h, roughly matching the 3 trucks at about 66 t/h, so no stockpile-full problem.

Other loan options were skipped. Drilling and fill stopes cannot lend a loader (LOADER-SOURCE-01). LH-07 and the other producing loaders are better left in place. Truck and stockpile figures are my own estimates from the map and the truck factor.

The radio and the CMMS agree on all three breakdowns (LH-01, LH-02 and LH-03, each hydraulic, repair 2-5 h). CONFIRM-01 is therefore not triggered. About 6.7 loading hours remain (09:50-11:00 and 11:30-17:00). Keep the two loans already in force. LH-08 covers C512-10: 124 t left at 13.4 g/t is about 53 oz, against 0.5 oz/h given up at DS-N600-01, about 3 oz. LH-09 covers N600-08: about 157 t reachable at 11.5 g/t is about 58 oz, against 2.0 oz/h given up at DS-N522-02, about 13 oz, so the net is about +45 oz. New loan: LH-07 (LH410) goes from TJ-C590-14 (6.7 g/t, 169 t left, 80 m from the stockpile) to TJ-E569-01 (10.4 g/t, 319 t left, 280 m from the stockpile, so about 23.6 t/h). Travel is about 0.45 h. It works about 2 h before LH-03 is repaired (likely 3 h), which is about 47 t and 15.8 oz. C590-14 loses about 33 t, about 7 oz. The net is about +9 oz. The Este stockpile is 112 of 450 t, so there is room. I did not use LH-10 because it is in 500 h preventive maintenance until 14:00. I did not take LH-04, LH-05 or LH-06, because each is producing at its own stope. I activated no reserve, because no stope is stopped. The estimate of about +9 oz is for the new LH-07 loan only. The two existing loans are kept and are not counted in it.
